skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Define and analyze the concept of services and classify them, understand the role of the service industry and service organizations in the economy.
Analyze customer behavior during the purchase and consumption of services in the context of Industry 4.0.
Analyze the differences and characteristics of service marketing, present the service system of a service organization, and apply marketing in the service sector.
Integrate knowledge about service marketing and experience in purchasing and consuming services to solve business and service marketing problems.
Possess the ability and skills to communicate verbally and in writing, work independently and in teams on applied service marketing at a specific service organization.
Apply awareness of social context, professional ethics, and social responsibility to build autonomous and responsible capabilities in work.
